test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

An elderly lady was knocked down by a speeding car this morning.

options.text: A speeding car was knocking down an elderly lady this morning.
A speeding car knocks down an elderly lady this morning.
A speeding car knocked down an elderly lady this morning.
A speeding car had knocked down an elderly lady this morning.

solution:
The correct answer is- 'A speeding car knocked down an elderly lady this morning.' 

***__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the past indefinite tense.

 
 
• So the structure for conversion is

 
 
• *subject + verb (3rd form) + object*
 
• Example: 
 
 
• An umbrella was brought by Rohan from the market. *(**passive**)
 
• *Rohan brought an umbrella from the market. *(**active**)
 
 
 
 
 
 

Thus *option 3 *is the correct answer. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ *​​​***

 
• Let's understand how the sentence structure changes in the past tense while converting from active to passive voice:

 
 
• Simple past- *subject + was/were + verb (3rd form) + object*

 
 
• *​*Example: *Football was played by him.*
 
 
 
• Past continuous - *subject + was/were + being + verb (3rd form) + object*
 
 
• *​*Example: *The car was being driven by him.*
 
 
 
• Past perfect - *subject + had + been + verb (3rd form) + object*
 
 
• *​*Example: *The car had been driven by him.*
